method: ENTIRELY from ONE AMH page, read under subscription and PARAPHRASED. No passage reproduced, no source_text stored, so NOTHING here is machine re-checkable and every statement must be verified by a person against a current subscription. ⚠️ NO mg DOSE OF ANY TREATMENT OR PREVENTIVE DRUG APPEARS ON THE PAGE, other than the ascorbic acid ceiling. The page's most transferable content is the COUNTER-INTUITIVE FLUID ADVICE IN ACUTE COLIC and the list of DRUGS THAT CAUSE OR WORSEN STONES.

claims.claim: KIDNEY STONES ARE COMMON and RENAL COLIC DUE TO MOVEMENT OF A STONE INTO THE URETER IS THE MOST COMMON SYMPTOM. ⚠️ 70-80% CONSIST OF CALCIUM OXALATE AND/OR CALCIUM PHOSPHATE, WITH 5-10% CONTAINING URIC ACID
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Kidney stones' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/genitourinary-drugs/other-drugs-urinary-tract-disorders/kidney-stones, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ACUTE RENAL COLIC: ⚠️ UNLESS CONTRAINDICATED, USE AN NSAID (ANY ROUTE) FIRST-LINE TO RELIEVE PAIN. ⚠️ OPIOIDS CAUSE HIGH RATES OF VOMITING AND MAY BE CONSIDERED ONLY IF NSAIDs ARE INADEQUATE
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Kidney stones' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/genitourinary-drugs/other-drugs-urinary-tract-disorders/kidney-stones, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ THE COUNTER-INTUITIVE POINT: IN ACUTE RENAL COLIC, NORMAL FLUID INTAKE IS RECOMMENDED. INCREASING URINE OUTPUT THROUGH HIGH FLUID INTAKE IS LIKELY TO INCREASE THE RISK OF OBSTRUCTION AND WORSEN PAIN
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Kidney stones' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/genitourinary-drugs/other-drugs-urinary-tract-disorders/kidney-stones, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: SELECTIVE ALPHA-BLOCKERS are sometimes used in SELECTED PATIENTS WITH LOWER URETERAL STONES UNDER 10 mm to help stone passage -- ⚠️ ONLY PATIENTS WITH STONES 5-10 mm IN SIZE ARE LIKELY TO BENEFIT, DUE TO THE HIGH SPONTANEOUS PASSAGE RATE OF UP TO 89% FOR SMALLER STONES. SURGERY MAY BE REQUIRED
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Kidney stones' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/genitourinary-drugs/other-drugs-urinary-tract-disorders/kidney-stones, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: PREVENTION: ⚠️ THE RECURRENCE RATE IS HIGH. INCREASING FLUID INTAKE -- TO ACHIEVE A URINE OUTPUT ABOVE 2 L DAILY IF POSSIBLE -- IS IMPORTANT IN PREVENTION. Dietary measures such as RESTRICTING SALT INTAKE may also help, and ⚠️ NORMAL DIETARY CALCIUM INTAKE IS RECOMMENDED -- NOT RESTRICTED
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Kidney stones' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/genitourinary-drugs/other-drugs-urinary-tract-disorders/kidney-stones, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ THE FLUID ADVICE IS OPPOSITE IN THE TWO SETTINGS: NORMAL FLUID INTAKE DURING ACUTE COLIC, BUT INCREASED FLUID INTAKE FOR PREVENTION. WHEN FLUID AND DIETARY MEASURES ARE INEFFECTIVE, CONSIDER DRUG TREATMENT to prevent new stones or growth of existing stones -- SEEK SPECIALIST ADVICE
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Kidney stones' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/genitourinary-drugs/other-drugs-urinary-tract-disorders/kidney-stones, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: PREVENTIVE DRUGS: ALLOPURINOL decreases urinary urate and is used for URIC ACID OR CALCIUM OXALATE STONES IN PEOPLE WITH HYPERURICOSURIA. POTASSIUM CITRATE increases urine pH and citrate concentration and inhibits crystal formation -- used for URIC ACID OR CALCIUM OXALATE STONES, ESPECIALLY IN PEOPLE WITH HYPOCITRATURIA. THIAZIDE DIURETICS reduce calcium excretion -- used for CALCIUM STONES IN PEOPLE WITH HYPERCALCIURIA
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Kidney stones' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/genitourinary-drugs/other-drugs-urinary-tract-disorders/kidney-stones, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ DRUGS THAT AFFECT STONE RISK: WHETHER ASCORBIC ACID INCREASES THE RISK OF CALCIUM OXALATE STONE FORMATION IS UNCLEAR, BUT DOSES ABOVE 1 g DAILY SHOULD BE AVOIDED. The effect of CALCIUM AND/OR VITAMIN D SUPPLEMENTATION on recurrence IS UNCLEAR -- use with caution, and ADVISE THAT CALCIUM SUPPLEMENTS ARE TAKEN WITH FOOD TO BIND OXALATE AND DECREASE URINARY OXALATE EXCRETION
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Kidney stones' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/genitourinary-drugs/other-drugs-urinary-tract-disorders/kidney-stones, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ CARBONIC ANHYDRASE INHIBITORS -- eg ACETAZOLAMIDE, TOPIRAMATE -- CAN INCREASE THE RISK OF CALCIUM PHOSPHATE STONES. PROBENECID CAN INCREASE THE RISK OF URIC ACID STONES. ⚠️ RENALLY EXCRETED DRUGS WITH LOW SOLUBILITY AT URINE pH, eg CIPROFLOXACIN, MAY CRYSTALLISE IN THE URINARY TRACT FORMING STONES, ESPECIALLY AT HIGH DOSES
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Kidney stones' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/genitourinary-drugs/other-drugs-urinary-tract-disorders/kidney-stones, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22
